claim: With the configuration single_cam_red_noDMD_nocom10.cfg loaded, the camera opened as Micro-Manager label Kinetix_red reports serial number A24M723015, chip TMP-Kinetix, firmware 30.48. That is the serial camera_bodies_are_told_apart_by_serial gives for the red arm, so in this configuration the label Kinetix_red opens the red-arm body.
validity_conditions: Read back in a preparatory run -- the first real acquisition on this computer, with no plan, the person having placed the 20x and moved the microscope by hand, software moving nothing. A device's report of itself may enter citing such a run (11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b), graded as an observation by this system: E1 from `measured:`. Not a value of any registered observable. The comparison with the stored serial is this seat's, from two records: the serial here is E1, the red-arm assignment it is compared with is E3 from the prior project, so the conclusion 'this label opens the red-arm body' is only as good as the E3 half. A frame on each arm with the other dark would settle the assignment here. A different configuration may map labels to bodies differently.
